usage: These audio exports are embedded in pi-workspace as application notification cues. They must not be redistributed as standalone sounds or a sound pack.

renderer.method: Executed the original renderer from const TAU through renderSound, excluding only the React import and unused interactive playback/hook code; executed the original encodeWav function without its module export keyword. No synthesis or audio processing logic was rewritten.
renderer.tuneMeaning: All original defaults: pitch 0, tone 0, length 1, space 0, punch 0, volume 0 dB, variation 0, no additional effects. Recipe-defined synthesis, reverb, trimming, fades and loudness normalization are retained.
renderer.postProcessing: None. The WAVs are original renderSound output encoded by upstream encodeWav.

sounds.description: A soft string pluck for picking from a list.
A neutral, airy tone for tips and info.

playback: macOS /usr/bin/afplay -v <playbackGain> <asset>. Pluck is unattenuated. Hint is played at 0.6 amplitude (approximately -4.44 dB relative to its original); the bundled asset itself is unchanged.
